headline: Greek F-4 Phantom fighter jet crashes during air show
summary: The aircraft plummeted after takeoff, causing an explosion in front of thousands of spectators at the 'Athens Flying Week'.
details: A Greek Air Force F-4 Phantom fighter jet crashed at a military base near Athens during a public exhibition. The incident occurred on Saturday, according to the state news agency ANA.
Witnesses, including a journalist from the public broadcaster ERT, reported that the jet suddenly lost altitude immediately after takeoff and plummeted downward.
The crash was followed by a a large explosion. The accident happened in front of thousands of spectators who had gathered for the annual 'Athens Flying Week' air show.
Fire service helicopters were deployed to the scene to extinguish the resulting fires. The exact cause of the crash remains unclear at this time.

The fate of the two pilots on board the aircraft has not yet been disclosed. Greece's Defense Minister Nikos Dendias canceled a scheduled visit to the Thessaloniki International Fair to visit the crash site.

headline_marked: Man with Tk 5 lakh [[found dead on Dhaka Elevated Expressway]]
headline: Man with Tk 5 lakh found dead on Dhaka Elevated Expressway
summary: The victim, identified as Ismail Hossain from Gazipur, was allegedly killed for money after selling land in Jamalpur.
details: Ismail Hossain, 50, was found dead on the Dhaka Elevated Expressway in Banani on Friday with his mouth taped. His family believes he was targeted by robbers for Tk 5 lakh he was carrying from a land sale in Jamalpur.

Ismail had sold 11 decimals of land for Tk 10.5 lakh to help repay family debts. After settling some debts and spending on a house, he left Jamalpur for Gazipur late Thursday night with the remaining funds.

His son, Md Hasan, waited for him at the Zirabo bus stand in Ashulia on Friday morning, but Ismail never arrived and his phone was switched off. Police later informed the family that his body had been discovered on the expressway.
Police suspect Ismail was strangled to death before being dumped from a vehicle. Analysis of CCTV footage from the expressway is currently underway to identify the suspects.
Law enforcement agencies have detained three individuals in connection with the case, including the driver, helper, and supervisor of the bus Ismail is believed to have used.
